name: Child of Nature
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Greetings, young champion.

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: Greetings, fellow champion. It pleases me to meet a fellow champion from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.I think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
